name: codex-hud
description: Local dynamic HUD for the active Codex CLI session

interface.shortDescription: Show live Codex session telemetry beside Codex
interface.longDescription: Adds an opt-in, local-only HUD for the current Codex account and session. It uses eight base rows and expands to at most eleven rows for unfinished and recently completed Todo items. macOS standalone Ghostty uses a native split; tmux panes remain the fallback for nested tmux and non-Ghostty terminals. It displays official-parity context pressure, tool and subagent activity, Todo progress, cache usage, estimated API-equivalent cost, quotas, and elapsed session time.
